answer_1.quote: We explore the extension of large‑scale conversational agents to image‑based dialogue... we combine representations... to produce responses conditioned on both visual and textual context. We generate model responses during inference... and evaluate on datasets such as COCO Captions and Image‑Chat.
answer_1.outputs: Generated textual dialogue responses and image captions

answer_2.quote: We compare our best multitask model on the various datasets... with F1, BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L. We also measure model perplexity on the COCO and Reddit validation sets.

answer_4.quote: We compare MMB Style to BlenderBot by having crowdsourced workers chat with our models, over 50 conversations per model... For ACUTE‑Evals we ask raters to compare conversations on Preference ("Who would you prefer to talk to for a long conversation?") and Humanness ("Which speaker sounds more human?").
answer_4.guideline: Raters are asked to answer Preference and Humanness questions and also rate Engagingness, Image‑response quality, and issue flags such as contradiction or repetitiveness.
